text: hi everybody I am frequently asked why I use the substitution Adonai which is the Hebrew word for Lord in place of
pronouncing the Divine name the tetragramaton and there is a uh scholarly reconstruction of how that name was likely pronounced anciently
that I agree with and that I will use in purely academic settings and it is the academic standard but in my public
facing scholarship which I have primarily produced for social media and other similar Outlets I've had a number
of requests from Jewish folks uh asking me not to use that pronunciation but to use a substitution and that is not a
very costly thing for me to do and I would like to uh do whatever is reasonable to help my public facing
scholarship be as accessible as it can be for folks and I find that to be a perfectly reasonable request and so you
will always see me um over about the last year and going forward using that substitution rather than uh the
scholarly reconstruction of the pronunciation of the tetragramaton
